correctness.rationale: Central inversion swaps arcs when n is even. For n=2k+1, positive and opposite line rays meet prescribed polygon edges; exact barycentric edge intersection parameters u=t/[sin2β+(1−cos2β)t], v=(1+t cotβ)/2 with t=tanα, β=π/n. Counting k−u+v and n−(k−u+v) edge units gives signed gap (1/2)tanαtan(β−α) and hence fraction. Maximizing (cos(2α−β)−cosβ)/(cos(2α−β)+cosβ) uniquely at α=β/2 proves all n extremal lines, endpoints are n reflection axes and every intermediate value occurs. The expansion tan²z=z²+(2/3)z⁴+O(z⁶) yields deficit π²/(8n³)+π⁴/(48n⁵)+O(n⁻⁷). An independently written geometric line-edge intersection routine checked odd n=3,5,7,9 and even n=12 across five angles each to 2×10⁻¹³, including n=3 minimum 4/9; the proof is continuous in α and valid for all n.
